summary: Late-1930s Virginia Department of Forestry Aermotor tower in Madison County, removed in 2018 over liability concerns. Reached by a rough jeep trail.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor tower with a 7 x 7 cab

access.note: Jeep trail crosses Rapidan Wildlife Management Area land and adjoining private hunting land; a WMA access permit may be required.

visit.trail_note: No tower left to climb. Steep, rugged jeep trail of about 9 miles from Ruth Road (SR 658), roughly 740 feet of elevation gain.

facts.status_note: Removed in 2018 over liability concerns. A guide says nothing is to see at the summit beyond an FAA radio site, which the registers do not mention.

notes_for_editor: The build year is only 'late 1930s' in the sources, so no built event is recorded (an event needs a year). The two registers agree on the 2018 removal and the Rappahannock Electric Cooperative link. The access details and the FAA radio site come from one rock-collecting guide, which itself marks some points as unverified; check the Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources rules before any visit. Record coordinates 38.4274, -78.33713 differ from the guide's 38.42377, -78.33808. Agency is the current administrator per the NHLR; the original builder was the Virginia Department of Forestry.
